copy_script:
@echo off
if exist C:\xwn610-kit goto fail
mkdir C:\xwn610-kit
copy D:\FIXTURE.DLL C:\xwn610-kit\FIXTURE.DLL
if errorlevel 1 goto fail
copy D:\SUBJECT.EXE C:\xwn610-kit\SUBJECT.EXE
if errorlevel 1 goto fail
copy D:\LIFEA.DLL C:\xwn610-kit\LIFEA.DLL
if errorlevel 1 goto fail
copy D:\LIFEB.DLL C:\xwn610-kit\LIFEB.DLL
if errorlevel 1 goto fail
copy D:\TRACE.EXE C:\xwn610-kit\TRACE.EXE
if errorlevel 1 goto fail
copy D:\RUN610.EXE C:\xwn610-kit\RUN610.EXE
if errorlevel 1 goto fail
attrib -R C:\xwn610-kit\*.*
echo XWN610 READY - EJECT CD BEFORE RUNNING
exit
:fail
echo COPY FAILED
pause
